Name: Vanilla Goat Udders Removed
Author: FastFantasticA
Description:
[size=4][b]IN NO WAY DO I CLAIM OWNERSHIP OF THIS SPRITESHEET PNG. THIS IS SIMPLY AN EDITED VERSION OF THE ORIGINAL GOAT.PNG FROM STARDEW VALLEY OWNED BY THE CREATOR ConcernedApe[/b][/size]


[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Have you ever looked at the Goat and got a little weirded out/felt uncomfortable by those Udders that are hanging so low that they could almost scrape the floor ? Yes ? Well then look no further than thzis mod which completely removes the Udders while preserving the Vanilla Goat Sprite. (And yes the shadows beneath the Goat work too :)[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Install the Latest Version of SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Install the Latest Verison of ContentPatcher[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Download this mod[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4 Unzip the mod and put the Folder named[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]   [CP] Vanilla Goat Udders Removed[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]   into your Stardew Valley Mods Folder[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Added Shadow Pixels inplace of deleted Udder pixels[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- How does it work: This Mod only replaces the Goat sprite, it does  not edit or change anything else, not even the Baby Goat Sprite[/color]


[b][size=4]Incompatibilities[/size][/b]
This mod replaces the vanilla goat sprite using Content Patcher.
It is propably incompatible with other mods that also edit or replace
 
Stardew Valley\Content\Animals\Goat.png

because only one replacement can be applied at a time.
Mods that do not modify the goat sprite work normally.


[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI, ContentPatcher[/color]



[size=4][b]Disclaimer:[/b][/size]
This mod does not include any of the Original unedited Stardew Valley Sprites.
This mod uses and modifies 1 original Stardew Valley asset created by Eric Barone.
All original game assets, character likenesses, and Stardew Valley-related content are the property of ConcernedApe.
This mod is a fanmade ContentPatcher edit by me and does not claim ownership of the original artwork. The modifications I made are the removal of the udder pixels from the vanilla goat sprite and then a little colouring of the outlines where the Udders were :)
